target_customer: PC gamers of League of Legends, Valorant and Teamfight Tactics who want coaching; planned paid tier of a few dollars per month
problem: Players improve slowly without coaching. SenpAI offered pre-game recommendations, in-game voice and overlay alerts using on-screen information, and post-game feedback.
business_model: Freemium desktop app with planned subscription for advanced features

founders.name: Olcay Yilmazcoban
previous_startups: Three-time founder per the YC page (names not given)
founders.background_notes: Described as MIT researcher, gamer and former VC investor on the YC page.

founders.name: Berk Ozer
previous_startups: Two-time entrepreneur per the YC page

technical_complexity.rationale: Computer vision overlays and a voice assistant across several live games, working only through approved game APIs and screen information, needed real-time ML on consumer hardware.

defensibility.rationale: Game publisher API access and screen reading are open to rivals; no network effect or exclusive data is described.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Publishers controlled API access. No copying event was found in sources opened.

market_need_then: TechCrunch in August 2021 reported over 400,000 active users and a team of 11, evidence of consumer pull for coaching tools.

branding.name_origin: Senpai is a Japanese honorific for a senior or mentor; the company's own reason for choosing it was not found
branding.domain_note: Uses senpai.gg; the registration later expired and the domain was parked at a registrar
branding.brand_signature: AI senpai as a personal coach
branding.community_and_virality: 400,000 active users reported in 2021; SENPAI.GG trademark filed September 2020 by FalconAI Technologies per a trademark listing

brand_strength.rationale: A culturally fitting name for gamers with a registered trademark, and TechCrunch coverage, but no evidence of viral or community brand pull.

outcome_analysis: SenpAI.GG built a free AI coaching app for League of Legends, Valorant and Teamfight Tactics and reported over 400,000 active users in August 2021 with a team of 11. It claimed a $3M seed from ACT Venture Partners. YC now lists it inactive and the senpai.gg domain registration has lapsed, but no closure announcement or cause is public, so the cause is not known and no failure factors are assigned.
notes: Seed amount rests on the YC page company description; TechCrunch did not state funding. Databases conflict: Employbl shows 2.5M EUR, CB Insights total 3.2M, VCBacked about 125K. Round date unknown. Competitor lists found (Mobalytics, Overwolf, Blitz) were from 2025 and 2026 sources, so none are listed as of founding. Stage label seed comes from the company statement.
